timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,512.4 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently weak at 1,512.4 KRW per USD (up 0.8 won from previous close), meaning you need more won to get your $2,000. News indicates this high exchange rate has persisted despite the Middle East situation easing, and structural factors suggest the won will remain weak "for some time" rather than strengthen soon.

TIP: Consider setting up a standing order or hedging strategy to spread your monthly conversions across multiple days/weeks, as waiting for a stronger won (lower KRW/USD rate) may be more cost-effective than converting all at once during sustained weakness.
